comum.semMatriculaTexto: This part of the School is tied to your enrolment. Enrol once and it opens, along with everything else.
comum.semMatriculaOQueE: Your sign-up to the School: three quick questions about what brings you here, how much time you have each week and what your internet is like.
comum.semMatriculaOQueDa: Your student number and card, suggested courses, the weekly plan, the record book and graduation.
comum.semMatriculaOQuePede: No name, email or ID. It is kept on this device only.
comum.noAparelho: Only on this device. None of this is sent to the Institute.
comum.naoEhDocumento: Record made on this device by the person themselves. It is not a certificate, not an official document and not proof of schooling. For official certification of schooling, the route is ENCCEJA.
comum.encceja: For official certification of schooling, the route is ENCCEJA.

caderneta.lead: What you studied and did, kept on your device: records, courses and estimated hours. You can print it or save it as PDF.

formatura.lead: Finishing a course means doing all the lessons and presenting the final project. Here you see what is missing, mark your graduation and keep the record.
formatura.projeto: Final project: the guide and the steps

projeto.lead: Each course ends with a project of your own, in six steps. You tick each one when you do it. Nothing is sent to anyone.
guia: Pick a small topic you can finish. A simple project that is done beats a big one that is stuck.
Write a short plan: what you will do, with which materials and in how many weeks.
Make a draft. It can be ugly; the goal is to have something to show.
Talk it over with a mentor, a colleague or a teacher, and note what to change.
Present it: at the class seminar or at a popular panel. A panel recorded in the notebook already counts as the presentation.
Keep the final version. If you want, publish it in the Open Drawer, with no faces and no full names.
projeto.orientacao: Mentoring, panel and seminar are on the pages of the course classes.

mural.lead: Prepares the text of an ad for you to copy and send through the Board's form. Only for released trade courses.

memoria.lead: A list curated by the coordination of people who wanted to appear: only a nickname and a short sentence.

registro.lead: A sheet to print or save as PDF, made on this device by you.

caderneta.semCursos: When you enroll in a course, the estimated hours appear here.
caderneta.avisoNomes: Do not write other people's full names, phone numbers or documents.
caderneta.erro: Could not save. Check the title and the date.
caderneta.confirmaRemover: Remove this record? It cannot be undone.
caderneta.vazioTexto: Recognized knowledge, panels and graduations appear here by themselves. You can also record a task or import a class receipt.

importar.lead: If you did a sequence of lessons in class mode, paste the receipt here (the text that starts with LUCIA-). You can paste several.
importar.semNome: The name you wrote on the receipt is not copied into the notebook.
importar.nenhum: No valid receipt in this text.
importar.invalidos: {n} cut or altered receipt(s) were ignored.
importar.concluiu: You finished {feitas} of {total} lessons of this class
importar.nadaAGuardar: No lesson done in this receipt: nothing to keep.
importar.comoChama: What do you call this class? (optional)

exportar.lead: Choose the records that go on the sheet. Other people's names and your enrollment number start switched off.
exportar.nadaParaExportar: There are no records to export yet.
exportar.nomesDeTerceiros: Include the names of those who assessed (they gave permission)
exportar.nomesDeTerceirosAviso: Only include them if the person still agrees.
exportar.nomeNaFolhaAviso: The name stays only on the screen and the sheet. It is not saved anywhere.
exportar.imprimirDica: In the print window, choose "Save as PDF".
exportar.tituloDaFolha: Worker's notebook · Escola Revolucionária Lúcia Maria

gaveta.titulo: Publish the project in the Open Drawer
gaveta.lead: If you want, the final project can stay open for other people to learn from. Copy the block below and use it in the Drawer's form. Nothing is filled in automatically.
gaveta.lembrete: No faces, no full names and nobody's documents. Only publish what is yours or what you have permission to publish.
gaveta.naoCopiou: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.

projeto.avisoNotas: Notes stay only on this device. Do not write other people's names.
projeto.naoSalvou: Could not save on this device.
projeto.semCurso: You have not enrolled in any course yet.

plano.texto: Write what, how and in how much time.

rascunho.texto: Make a first version, even an imperfect one.

revisao.texto: Talk it over with a mentor, a colleague or a teacher.

apresentacao.texto: Show it at the class seminar or at a popular panel.

entrega.texto: Keep the final version. Publishing in the Drawer is optional.

cerimonia.parabensTexto: You finished the course: all the lessons and the final project. The record is already in your notebook.
cerimonia.confirmarTitulo: I confirm: I finished this course
cerimonia.confirmarTexto: The graduation is marked on this device and cannot be undone. Confirm?
cerimonia.erro: Could not mark the graduation. Try again.
cerimonia.confirmo: I confirm: I finished this course

formatura.criterioProposto: Proposed criterion, to be confirmed by the coordination.
formatura.semCurso: You have not enrolled in any course yet.

motivos.semInscricao: You are not enrolled in this course on this device.
motivos.trancada: The course is paused. Go back to it to graduate.
motivos.semAulas: The course has no lessons yet.
motivos.faltaTema: The topic is not marked yet.
motivos.faltaApresentacao: The presentation is missing (seminar or popular panel).

registro.semFormatura: You have not marked any graduation on this device yet.
registro.escola: Escola Revolucionária Lúcia Maria · Instituto Lúcia
registro.concluiu: Finished the course {curso}: all the lessons and the final project presented.
registro.imprimirDica: In the print window, choose "Save as PDF".

mural.avisoIdade: Service ads are for people aged 18 or over.
mural.semCurso: You have not enrolled in any course yet.
mural.semAnuncio: This course does not prepare you to offer the service. Look for a qualified professional.
mural.semContato: Do not write a phone number, e-mail or address here. You type contact and city only in the Board's form.
mural.erroContato: The text seems to have a phone number, e-mail or link. Take it out.
mural.erroOficio: Write the trade with at least 4 letters.
mural.naoCopiou: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.
mural.moderacao: The Board reviews ads before publishing. The School does not certify or guarantee the quality of the service.

memoria.aviso: Only people who asked, are 18 or over and agreed in writing appear; only a nickname and a short sentence, no photo and no full name.
memoria.listaEmRevisao: The list is under review by the coordination and is not being shown.
memoria.vazia: Nobody is in the memory yet. When you graduate and want to appear, the request is right below.
memoria.retirada: Anyone who wants off the list is removed right away, with no need to explain.
memoria.semFormatura: The request appears for people who already marked their graduation on this device. The political education and struggles history courses are not in the memory, so nobody's political opinion is revealed.
memoria.pedidoLead: Write how you want to be called and copy the text. You send it through Contribute, under "An idea". Nothing is sent automatically.
memoria.apelido: Nickname (how you want to be called)
memoria.apelidoNaoServe: Use only a nickname: no full name, e-mail, phone or @.
memoria.maiorDeIdade: I am 18 or over and I authorize the use of the nickname.
memoria.menores: People under 18 are not offered the memory: the law protects the image and identity of children and teenagers.
memoria.naoCopiou: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.
